doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Taking whatever piano was provided
summary: Early on she did not know piano brands and played whatever was tuned and given to her.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Getting back to your different techniques, when you were playing did you prefer a certain type of piano? A certain brand did you ask for?
I didn’t know the difference back then. I took what I could get. People would give you a piano to play on, I’d say, “This ain’t no good.” They’d say, “They tuned it, so it must be alright.”
They didn’t care about the touch of the piano, the quality?
They were lucky to have a piano.
